notes: This is a research selection record, not a model promotion manifest.
Do not substitute a CSL-only or WLASL isolated-sign checkpoint.
No How2Sign validation examples may be silently reassigned to training.
Full-utterance loader does not inherit upstream random max_length frame subsampling.
Official online demo processes a supplied video and does not establish Neosignis live streaming latency.
Input normalization uses whole-utterance body bounds and is noncausal; live window behavior must be evaluated separately.
Reviewed upstream model forward truncates targets at 50 tokens. This path must be adapted and retested before variable-length target training.
The implemented pose adapter is independently written and tested with synthetic poses; actual extractor/checkpoint numerical parity is not yet established.
